nuggets.text: Braxton Woodson ran for 200 yards and three touchdowns against Towson, the most rushing yards by a Navy player since 2024.
The Midshipmen piled up 506 rushing yards against Towson, the 12th-most in school history.
Braxton Woodson is from Altamonte Springs, one of 23 Midshipmen from the state of Florida.
Jackson Gutierrez is the only FBS player on a three-deep depth chart at quarterback and another position, running back.
The Midshipmen have won 79 straight home games when leading after three quarters, the nation's longest streak.
Former Mid Joe Cardona is entering his 12th NFL season, passing Roger Staubach for the longest NFL career by a Navy player.
At Navy, attendance at home football games is required for all students.
In 1960, Air Force kidnapped Navy mascot Bill the Goat and flew him off in the bomb bay of a B-26.
Brian Newberry was a Glacier National Park tour guide growing up and once paused coaching to weigh a photography career.
The Midshipmen have produced two Heisman winners: Joe Bellino in 1960 and Roger Staubach in 1963.
